skill.name: Brush Region Selection
skill.description: Enable interactive one- or two-dimensional region selection using mouse or touch input. Provides a reusable interaction pattern for data filtering or zooming.
skill.skill_body:
Invoke this skill when you need to capture user-initiated spatial selection on a visualization. The skill binds mouse and touch event handlers to a DOM selection, maintains region state, and exposes the selected boundary for downstream filtering or transformation. Use axis scales to constrain selection to data domains.

## Objective

Capture user-initiated spatial selection for filtering or navigation
## Applicable Signals

- User needs to select a rectangular or linear region
- Implementing data filtering UI
- Implementing zoom or range selection
- Interactive visualization requires region-based input

## Contraindications

- Selection is not needed or not part of the interaction model
- Interaction is point-based rather than region-based
- Using non-mouse/touch input methods exclusively
- Static or read-only visualization

## Workflow Steps

- Bind brush interaction to a DOM selection or SVG group
- Configure brush orientation (one-dimensional or two-dimensional)
- Attach event listeners for brush start, move, and end
- Capture and store the selected region boundary
- Expose region state for downstream consumers (filters, scales, transforms)

## Constraints

- Requires a valid DOM selection or SVG element
- Mouse and touch events must be available in the execution environment
- Region boundary must be expressible in pixel or data coordinates

## Cautions

- Ensure event handlers do not conflict with other interaction patterns
- Coordinate with scale domains to map pixel selection to data ranges
- Test touch interaction on target devices

## Output Contract

- User-defined region boundary (extent or selection coordinates) captured and available for downstream filtering or transformation logic. Boundary is updated on brush move and finalized on brush end.
